# NASHA investor data room index (generated by tools/blueprint_views.py; do not hand-edit)

**Private index of pointers, not duplicated files. No investor has been contacted; nothing is public; the website stays noindex.** Lane B (digital planning). Evidence stays 4/95 and design 43/95: digital work never raises physical evidence.

## The story, stated honestly

NASHA is a concept for a food-and-beer house joining Indian and Mexican traditions in Austin. The founder is using the pre-capital phase to remove as much uncertainty as possible before asking anyone to fund expensive uncertainty: what has been documented with time and research (concept, product system, operating and economic model structures with every number still unknown, risk map, data room); what has been tested personally (NOTHING YET: Session 1 is prepared, not performed); what requires capital (professional review, commercial pilots, brewing, site, build); and what each dollar would de-risk (see use of funds). The amounts are not set; no fundraising claim is made.

## Documented, and not proven

| DOCUMENTED (written down, not tested) | NOT PROVEN |
|---|---|
| A coherent concept, Core 5 food and beer design, operating, kitchen, brewery and guest blueprints, a provenance-aware economic model, risk register and data room | That any dish works or any guest wants it; that any beer can be brewed to brief; unit economics; legal structure; the name; the site; the brewery case |
| Evidence 4/95 and design 43/95, reported unchanged by digital work | Everything requiring a physical test, a professional, a customer or a quote |

## Capital stages (no amounts; hospitality investors, strategic and brewery partners, angels, later debt and founder capital all considered; venture capital is not assumed)

| Stage | Funds | Unlocks | Sources to consider | Must be true first | Claim status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **CS0 PRE-CAPITAL** | Founder time, retail ingredients, phone photography, free modelling | Personal prototype baseline; digital blueprint; data room | founder time | none | IN PROGRESS |
| **CS1 MICRO VALIDATION CAPITAL** | Ingredients, supplier samples, transport, basic photo materials,... | Repeated prototypes; first real cost data; possible small... | founder savings; friends and family only if the founder chooses | Session 1 completed; decision gate BG-2 not passed for sale | NOT RAISED |
| **CS2 PRE-SEED / CONCEPT CAPITAL** | Legal and IP, formation, food and beer pilots, brand finalization,... | Name decision; professional reviews; commercial pilots | angels; hospitality investors; strategic or brewery partners; grants... | blueprint, prototype evidence and risk disclosure ready | NOT RAISED; no fundraising target set |
| **CS3 SITE CAPITAL** | Site diligence, design, permitting professionals | Location, drawings, cost estimates | hospitality investors; partners; possible debt later | pilots show demand and unit economics | NOT RAISED |
| **CS4 BUILD CAPITAL** | Construction, equipment, brewery | Physical venue | investors; SBA or other debt where appropriate; landlord contribution | earlier gates passed (bm-gates.csv) | NOT RAISED |
| **CS5 OPENING CAPITAL** | Staff, inventory, launch, working capital | Public opening | investors; debt; founder capital later | build complete and licensed | NOT RAISED |

## Risks and how each will be tested

| Risk | Evidence today | Cheapest test | Horizon | What would change the plan |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **NAME RISK** | T1 search summaries only; no trademark record opened | IP attorney review of the prepared package | C (unfunded: LEGAL REVIEW REQUIRED) | counsel advises changing the name; brand-independent work continues |
| **PRODUCT RISK** | none | Session 1 and repeats at home | A | dishes fail D-74 gates; rework or cut |
| **CUSTOMER RISK** | none | structured lawful tastings once the dishes pass | B | low willingness to pay or low repeat |
| **BREWERY CAPEX RISK** | scale frameworks only | host-brewery or collaboration pilots | C | partner beer sells as well as own brews |
| **RESTAURANT MARGIN RISK** | model architecture; all inputs UNKNOWN | Session 1 receipts and yields; priced portion | A then B | negative contribution at achievable price |
| **SITE RISK** | scorecard blank | site diligence on candidate sites | C | site cannot host tanks or hood |
| **CULTURAL RISK** | internal agent checks only | Indian and Mexican advisor review | C | advisors reject names, claims or dish framing |
| **EXECUTION RISK** | capacity exercise (assumptions) | measured ticket times in pilots | A then B | station limits cap covers below break-even |
| **FOUNDER / TEAM GAP** | team-blueprint.csv | founder cooking evidence; recruit partners when capital exists | B/C | no qualified partners join |
| **REGULATORY RISK** | question tree only | attorney and authority answers | C | structure not lawful for a format |

No TAM/SAM/SOM, projections, customers, sales, quotes, margins, permits, clearance or investor interest exist or are implied.
